project: MD-UA-BY-RU official-source candidates and immutable GeoNames integrity audit

MD.name: Moldova

official_candidates.name: Clasificatorul unităților administrativ-teritoriale (CUATM)
official_candidates.reuse_status: review official workbook license and 2025-10-17 revision before commercial redistribution
requirements: do not infer Transnistrian service coverage

known_issues: BNS CUATM is not a postal or road/address register

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.official_authority: Ministry for Development of Communities and Territories

official_candidates.name: КАТОТТГ codifier amendment effective/published 2026-07-07
official_candidates.reuse_status: official government open data attribution; pin exact 2026 XLSX and confirm sheet and source headers
requirements: separate prior codes and historical changes
do not infer wartime access or carrier delivery

known_issues: temporarily occupied/contested localities require evidence and dates, not invented national joins
source classification is not a carrier delivery map

BY.name: Belarus
BY.official_authority: National Statistical Committee / National Cadastral Agency

official_candidates.name: ОКРБ 003-2017 (СОАТО) classification of administrative and inhabited places
official_candidates.reuse_status: current public export and conditions not independently established
requirements: do not assume complete open street/house register

known_issues: identify a current official machine-readable download before asserting new national coverage

RU.name: Russia

official_candidates.name: Government address register (GAR/FIAS) XML ZIP 2026-11-03
official_candidates.format: regional XML ZIP / weekly full release
official_candidates.role: published address object and hierarchy observations; separate legal territory from issuer
official_candidates.reuse_status: open government dataset but exact raw snapshot, processing and downstream terms must be verified
requirements: process regional packages with streaming XML
retain OBJECTID and OBJECTGUID without recombining by name
do not label contentious border areas as internationally recognized country membership

official_candidates.name: OKATO state classifier 2026-08-01
official_candidates.reuse_status: open data publication, verify exact version and attribution

known_issues: full nationwide GAR snapshots are very large: use per-region immutable source pins
country claims of official datasets do not resolve disputed borders
